items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: Clarence William Paul was playing bass with him, Dennis William.

ctx.x: Did he play any fun with his band?

No, he didn't have no fun with Ron. He used to play for dancers mostly. And I tell you, he had to swell all because they used to sit down and make their own music. Just make up most of the whole program, the stuff they made up. And he used to have some dancers at that time. Quadrillion and lances. And he used to play shatters and zilting. And I said variety. And two steps, one steps. He used to play little rags too, and then he used to play sentimental music in the overtill. My father was a first class musician.…
Oh, tell about how old man Allen used to get jobs. Did you ever hear that story?
